column1: # The stock model property files of the Z9X (G0082) the image sets (tools/devices/model_props.py,
# z9x_model_props.rc): one row per vendor firmware whose file the stock dumps have (Z19 = the v6.15.19 dump, Z58 =
# the v6.15.58 dump, Z62 = the v6.15.62 dump, build.conf). v6.15.58 and v6.15.62 ship the same file, v6.15.19 differs
# in one line the image does not set (persist.vendor.xgimi.animation.style is commented out there).
# Only the lines a Lumen Z9X image reads (lines = read): /vendor/app and /vendor/priv-app are hidden at boot
# (xgimi_compat.rc), the stock system is replaced, so a line read only by an XGIMI app, the stock XRMService,
# libbootanimation or services.jar does nothing here. The seven '##trapezoid' lines are set by
# overlay/v1/z9x_trapezoid.rc since 1.0.8 (model only, any firmware) and are not repeated here. The file has no
# ro.xgimi.mem.policy, and nothing in the Z9X vendor reads persist.vendor.xgimi.hd_server (the vendor starts
# hd_server1..3 by service name), so neither is set. the design notes lists every line.
## The Z9X G0082 file on v6.15.19, v6.15.58 and v6.15.62: the lines a Lumen image reads, each with its reader in
## devices/horse_popular/image/z9x_model_prop_dapeng.txt. The trapezoid lines are in z9x_trapezoid.rc.
